description: Babymonster’s music video for “Deserve” surpassed 100 million views on YouTube in 11 days, according to label YG Entertainment on Wednesday. It is the group’s 19th music video to reach the milestone and the fastest music video to do so this year. The two-year-old team has over 13.5 million followers on its YouTube channel. “Deserve” is a pop ballad released as a digital single on Oct. 23, featuring six of its seven members. Main vocalist Rami has suspended activities since May 2025 due to health
title: Babymonster tops 100m views with ‘Deserve’ music video
